title: MissionOverlay
description: Editorial overlay per mission per locale (ADR-017, ADR-020). One file per mission per locale at i18n-src/[locale]/missions/[dest]/[id].json. Merged with the base record at fetch time.

vehicle.description: Localized launch vehicle / stack line (the base record's `vehicle`), shown on the /fly opening card and the mission panel.

dispatch.description: Editorial lead paragraph (PRD-029 / programs-editorial-voice.md §6) — the why-it-matters, in the programs voice, shown at the top of OVERVIEW. Authored when a program's roster links this mission. Optional; distinct from `description` (the facts).
